scientific_integrity: Analytic universal proof; code validates exact finite tests only; possible unlocated specialist prior; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Balanced part sizes, equal ordinary part masses, prescribed full-support stationary law, reversible discrete-time nearest-part transition matrices with self-loops and SLEM only. No global optimizer uniqueness; independent mathematical validation not performed. Earlier three-part and uniform-stationary cases are not claimed.
title: Four-phase reversible mixing and an isolated Metropolis optimum on biased multipartite graphs
